ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program students, specifically EOP and PAP students in the Liberal Arts & Sciences college. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 2002 Lincoln Hall to be placed on the LAS AAP waiting list. Open to LAS AAP Undeclared only to June 21.
